fingerprint_note: Generated release evidence documents matched by exclude_patterns remain included in the FullSource ZIP and are covered by ZIP CRC and archive SHA-256; they are excluded only from source/test input fingerprints to prevent self-referential evidence updates. Generated audit snapshots (Listening readiness, question evidence, distractors, editorial queue, content coverage, Foundation A2, major release/outcomes and glossary backlog) are also excluded from test-input fingerprints because their deterministic audit commands rewrite them before release tests; they remain included in FullSource and covered by the archive SHA-256. The GitHub Actions shell replay summary is generated evidence and is excluded from test-input fingerprints while remaining included in FullSource and its archive hash. Python test-shard reports, cross-module/iPad acceptance reports, glossary quality/candidate/queue snapshots and rendered viewport evidence are generated release evidence; they are excluded from the source/test-input fingerprint to prevent self-referential checkpoints, but remain in FullSource and are protected by archive CRC and SHA-256.
